label: FP
reason: The reported XSS paths target HTML content displayed via PrintWriter which is rendered as plain text rather than interpreted as HTML. The critical defense is HtmlUtils.htmlEscape applied to user input in doSomething method, preventing script execution regardless of where the escaped string appears in the response stream.

evidence.note: XSS sinks identified by CodeQL but lack actual HTML rendering context
HtmlUtils.htmlEscape sanitizes user input before it reaches any output
